items.text:
I couldn't get myself to give a thumbs down, because despite the state it's in even at 1.0+, I love this game. I want others to love this game. It's unique and has heart, and it scratches a very specific itch. The excitement when docking with a derelict, not knowing if you're about to have a band of pirates marching into your beat up pod like a clown car, or score big and go home with enough gear to build up your ship enough to go out longer and further is real, and it's a lot of fun building your ship to be just the way you want it.

But the unfortunate truth is that it came out undercooked. There's tons of bugs still. Some are just silly things that don't have much consequence (like the starting area seemingly having an endless parade of criminals coming in and starting punchfests with the locals), but others get you killed or lock you out of some content (inexplicable breathing issues, or not being able to do certain repeatable tasks because it was resolved incorrectly). Maybe it will be patched and expanded into what it was meant to be, but for now I can only recommend it with a huge asterisk. You might get a lot of fun out of it, but be ready for a lot of frustration on the side.
items.text_zh:
我没办法让自己点踩，因为尽管它处于1.0+的状态，我仍然热爱这款游戏。我希望其他人也热爱这款游戏。它独特且有灵魂，能挠到你某个非常具体的痒处。与废弃船只对接时的兴奋感是真实的——你不知道即将有一群海盗像小丑车一样涌进你那艘破旧的太空舱，还是会大赚一笔，带着足够装备回家，把你的飞船升级到能走得更远更久——而且把飞船打造成你想要的样子非常有趣。

但不幸的是，它推出时确实欠火候。仍然有大量bug。有些只是没什么后果的蠢事（比如起始区域似乎有无穷无尽的罪犯涌入，和当地人打成一团），但另一些会让你丧命或把你锁在某些内容之外（莫名其妙的呼吸问题，或者因为任务被错误地判定完成而无法进行某些可重复任务）。也许它会被修补并扩展成它本该成为的样子，但就目前而言，我只能带着一个巨大的星号来推荐它。你可能会从中获得很多乐趣，但也要准备好面对随之而来的大量挫败感。
